findings.title: Inconsistent collection type usage
findings.body: The module previously used `deque` for `_recent_batches` (line 3 removed), but the new code switches to `list` without a clear reason visible in the diff. The change introduces inconsistency with the existing codebase pattern for bounded collections, which favors `deque` for its O(1) append/pop from both ends. Consider keeping `deque` unless there is a specific performance or semantic need for `list`.

findings.title: Unclear rationale for collection type change
findings.body: The change from `deque` to `list` alters the behavior of `_recent_batches` by removing the automatic eviction of oldest items when the length exceeds 2. The diff does not explain why this change was made or what problem it solves. Adding a comment or updating the class docstring to clarify the intent would improve maintainability.

summary.problem: The change from `deque` to `list` for `_recent_batches` introduces inconsistency with the codebase and lacks justification.
summary.done_well: The refactor simplifies the type annotation and removes an unused import.
